newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher despite Russia jitters.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher despite Russia jitters.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed firmer on Thursday after weakness at the opening despite market jitters over the situation in Russia.
"When it is uneasy in that big country in the east then it is not good for anyone, not even the Stockholm bourse," one broker said.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.27 percent to 2,136.34 after shares worth 3.4 billion crowns changed hands.
The forestry sector index fell 0.91 percent and was one of the weakest sectors of the day. Stora fell 2.50 to 83.50.
Bluechips posted small gains during the day.
Telecoms giant Ericsson rose three crowns to 178.50 crowns and drugs major Astra ended up 0.50 at 306 crowns.

The bank sector rose 0.57 percent. Regional bank Foreningsbanken slipped 0.10 crowns to 27.50. Sweden's Financial Supervisory Board said it had reported suspected insider trading in the bank's shares to the state prosecutor.
